title: Expand the sample library with more LoC music
description: Add curated Library of Congress music (National Jukebox, Lomax/American Folklife, chants and work songs) beyond the Citizen DJ packs. Hand-curated catalog lists, ~20-50 excerpts per collection. Rhythm markup for chants is YAGNI until a real sample defeats the beat detector; flag suspect BPMs here. Web UI GROUPS/docs changes are coordinated here for the web/docs session.
